34:43.text: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, they say, "This is not but a man who wishes to avert you from that which your fathers were worshipping." And they say, "This is not except a lie invented." And those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, "This is not but obvious magic."

34:46.text: Say, "I only advise you of one

34:47.text: Say, "Whatever payment I might have asked of you - it is yours. My payment is only from Allāh, and He is, over all things, Witness."

34:48.text: Say, "Indeed, my Lord projects the truth, Knower of the unseen."
